scheme_name: Vishvakarma Durghatana Mrtyu par Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Raashi Bhugataan Yojana
description:
The Vishvakarma Durghatana Mrtyu par Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Raashi Bhugataan Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India to provide financial assistance to the families of workers who have lost their lives due to accidents while working in the unorganized sector.

This scheme was launched on 1st January 2021 as a part of the broader initiative to improve the welfare of workers engaged in hazardous occupations.

The primary objective of the scheme is to ensure that the families of deceased workers receive immediate financial support to cover funeral expenses and other related costs.

Under this scheme, the government provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹20,000 to the family of the deceased worker.

This amount is intended to help the family manage the immediate financial burden that arises from the loss of a breadwinner.

The scheme specifically targets workers in the unorganized sector who are often not covered under traditional labor laws and social security measures.

To be eligible for this scheme, the applicant must be a family member of a worker who has died due to an accident while working in the unorganized sector.

The worker must have been engaged in work that is classified as hazardous or risky.

There are no specific age limits for the deceased worker under this scheme.

However, the family must provide proof of the worker's employment in the unorganized sector.

The application process for the Vishvakarma Durghatana Mrtyu par Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Raashi Bhugataan Yojana is straightforward.

Interested applicants must fill out the application form available at designated government offices or online through the official government portal.

The application form requires details such as the name of the deceased worker, the nature of the accident, and the relationship of the applicant to the deceased.

Applicants must also submit a copy of the death certificate of the worker.

Additionally, proof of employment in the unorganized sector must be provided.

This could include documents such as wage slips, work contracts, or any other relevant employment records.

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities.

The review process typically takes about 30 days from the date of application submission.

If the application is approved, the financial assistance is disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant.

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India.

The Ministry has set up various helplines and contact points for applicants to seek assistance regarding the application process.

The helpline numbers and contact details can be found on the official Ministry of Labour and Employment website.

The scheme aims to provide timely support to families in distress, ensuring that they do not face additional hardships during their time of grief.

As of October 2023, the government has reported that over 10,000 families have benefited from this scheme since its inception.

The scheme is part of a larger framework aimed at improving the safety and welfare of workers in India.

The government has also been working on raising awareness about the scheme among workers in the unorganized sector.

Workshops and informational sessions have been organized in various states to educate workers about their rights and available benefits.

The Vishvakarma Durghatana Mrtyu par Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Raashi Bhugataan Yojana is a significant step towards recognizing the contributions of workers in hazardous jobs.

It acknowledges the risks they face and provides a safety net for their families in case of unfortunate incidents.

The scheme is expected to evolve over time to include more comprehensive support measures for workers and their families.

In addition to financial assistance, the government is exploring options for providing counseling and support services to grieving families.

This could include mental health support and guidance on navigating the challenges that arise after the loss of a family member.

The scheme is funded through the central government budget, which allocates specific amounts each year for worker welfare initiatives.

In the financial year 2021-2022, the government allocated ₹100 crores for the implementation of this scheme.

The allocation was increased to ₹150 crores in the subsequent financial year to accommodate the rising number of applications.

The government is also working on integrating this scheme with other welfare programs to provide a more holistic support system for workers.

This includes linking the scheme with health insurance and pension schemes for unorganized sector workers.

The Vishvakarma Durghatana Mrtyu par Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Raashi Bhugataan Yojana represents a crucial effort to ensure that the families of workers are not left destitute due to unforeseen circumstances.

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to improving the living standards of the working class in India.

It reflects an understanding of the vulnerabilities faced by workers in the unorganized sector and aims to provide them with a safety net.

The government continues to monitor the implementation of the scheme to ensure that it meets its objectives effectively.

Regular assessments and feedback mechanisms are in place to evaluate the impact of the scheme on beneficiaries.

The Vishvakarma Durghatana Mrtyu par Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Raashi Bhugataan Yojana is a vital initiative that underscores the importance of worker welfare in India's socio-economic landscape.

It serves as a reminder of the need for continuous efforts to enhance the safety and security of workers in all sectors.

The scheme is expected to play a significant role in reducing the financial burden on families during their most challenging times.

As the scheme progresses, the government aims to refine its processes and expand its reach to ensure that no family is left without support in their time of need.
